title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Phone multi-line (several phone numbers per user)
summary: Hold: the licensing field describes an additional entitlement although alternate lines use the primary line's licensing. Emergency-location management omits the Operator Connect qualification, and primary-line removal needs to distinguish manual unassignment from system deprovisioning. The notice gives expected rollout windows, not confirmation that those windows were met.

The notice does not confirm actual completion; retain the separately supported Launched roadmap status.
